text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: smart-routing anomalies detected for customer-facing routing policy 'fallback-v2' — unexpected region fallback churn (start=2160001111). auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.

sasha: saw this too. spikes in fallback to eu-west-1 starting ~2160001050. fallback rate ~18% in the last 5m, baseline 0.5%.

jordan: paging SRE now. @maria you oncall?

maria: oncall, looking. can someone post the quick metrics? p99, error types, region counts.

lee: past 10m: p50=120ms, p95=400ms, p99=1.8s for eu-west-1. fallback_count: total 4.2k -> eu-west-1 3.7k. global fallback rate 15%.

samir: logs show model-variant mismatch errors in eu-west-1: "variant_not_found" for model:rdw-instruct-xxl-quant. routing tried fallback -> variant pin -> incompatible kernel -> failures -> fallback again.

jordan: that sounds like the new variant alias mapping didn't roll out to eu-west. config change earlier today? @lee any config deploys?

lee: pushed alias mapping for rdw-instruct-xxl-quant at 2160000200 to prod; rollout target: global. can confirm eu-west reported success for other services but model onboarding hooks failed (403 on model registry pull) — suspect partial rollout.

maria: customers are seeing 429s and increased latency. @cari-support any customer reports?

cari-support: multiple enterprise tenants flagged errors: alpha-commerce (EU) saw 5xx -> degraded UX for their checkout flows. CS opened a ticket.

oncall-bot: page assigned to maria (SRE) and jordan (runtime). Incident severity: sev2. incident channel created: #inc-2160001111.

sasha: given partial rollout + mismatch, manual override might stop the loop if we force-route away from eu-west. BUT we should be careful — force-region can create sticky state.

jordan: agree. options: 1) force-route traffic for affected customers to us-east-1 2) roll back alias mapping 3) drain eu-west variants and let autoscale rebuild. Which is fastest? we need mitigation first.

maria: prefer safe rollback of alias mapping for that variant if possible, then let routing return to normal. but rollback might not be instant if nodes cache alias -> variant mapping.

lee: caches TTL is 60s but there is also a sticky route table that can persist for 5m if forced. note: previous incidents where we used force-pin caused loops because fallback policies prefer pinned variants and then fallback again.

samir: I can try a targeted force-route rule for the handful of affected tenant ids to us-east-1, to minimize global blast radius.

jordan: meh, historically the targeted force-route is fine. however if we push a force-region at the routing-policy level (`/routing force-region eu-west -> us-east-1`) it will create a policy override that lasts until revoked.

sasha: DON'T run a global `/routing force-region` yet. we had a case where force-region + immediate rollback created a sticky fallback loop. if you must, use per-tenant rule and include TTL.

jordan: ok will do per-tenant. commands I'll run:
```
# create temporary per-tenant override with 15m TTL
/routing override add --tenant=alpha-commerce --to-region=us-east-1 --ttl=900 --reason="mitigate eu-west fallback churn"
```

jordan: executing now.

ops-bot: ACTION: /routing override add --tenant=alpha-commerce --to-region=us-east-1 --ttl=900 --by=jordan --id=ovr-7421 --status=applied

sasha: good. monitor fallback rate.

lee: fallback rate for alpha-commerce dropped from 32% -> 3% in 30s. overall cluster fallback still 12% because other tenants are still routed to eu-west.

maria: we're seeing a new symptom: the override caused some long-lived KV cache entries for alpha-commerce pointing to eu-west->kv_shard_12. The routing layer attempted to honor override while KV cache retained eu-west mapping, causing inconsistent results (some requests hit us-east for model but kv reads from eu-west -> data mismatch -> errors).

samir: that's the sticky side-effect I feared. the per-tenant override is working, but we didn't clear the prefix caching. we need to evict KV prefixes for alpha-commerce.

jordan: can we evict with the cache tool? `kv-ops evict --tenant alpha-commerce --prefix /rdw/` ?

lee: yes. running eviction now. note: eviction is async and will cause some short bursts of higher load as caches miss.

ops-bot: JOB: kv-ops evict --tenant=alpha-commerce --prefix=/rdw/ --by=lee --job=evict-991

maria: monitoring customer errors -> decreased 5xx after eviction. good.

cari-support: alpha-commerce confirms checkout errors subsided.

sasha: we still have global garbage: the model alias rollback discussion — can we rollback mapping for rdw-instruct-xxl-quant in the registry? if config rollback is quick we should do it.

lee: rollback attempted: `/model-registry rollback --model rdw-instruct-xxl-quant --to-tag previous` result: partial success; eu-west failed earlier due to permissions. ops team says the registry issue likely related to the regional pull role being revoked.

jordan: ops-team, can you regrant the role? that's why eu-west couldn't fetch the variant.

samir: role regrant in progress. ETA ~3m.

oncall-bot: pager escalation: ops oncall anna assigned.

anna (ops, via message): regranted model-registry:pull role for eu-west service account. re-triggering alias sync now.

ops-bot: model-registry sync job kicked for eu-west (job id sync-204).

lee: sync succeeded. eu-west now sees variant alias mapping. starting gradual unroll of per-tenant override for alpha-commerce in 2m unless we see regressions.

jordan: removing override in 2m: `/routing override remove --id=ovr-7421 --by=jordan`

ops-bot: ACTION: /routing override remove --id=ovr-7421 --by=jordan --status=removed

sasha: monitor KV mismatch errors and fallback rate as override is removed.

maria: telemetry: fallback rate global dropped from 12% -> 1.1% over 5m. latency normalizing. no new 5xx spikes.

cari-support: alpha-commerce reported return to normal for checkout flows.

samir: summary of what happened: partial alias rollout + permissions glitch caused variant_not_found in eu-west -> routing fallback to other variants -> repeated attempts caused sticky pins and region churn; manual per-tenant force-route helped but exposed stale KV cache leading to partial data mismatch; eviction + role fix + alias sync resolved.

sasha: immediate post-incident actions: (1) write runbook update to forbid global `/routing force-region` during alias rollouts; (2) add automatic KV prefix eviction when per-tenant region override applied; (3) add preflight for alias rollouts to ensure registry pull perms in every region.

maria: assigning owners: runbook = sasha, kv-eviction automations = lee, preflight check = jordan. target: patch within 1 week.

jordan: will follow up with a brief incident blameless postmortem. creating ticket.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to sev3; customer impact mitigated. incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.

sasha: locking this thread for now. great work everyone. :tada:

maria: thanks all. adding notes to #postmortems and will schedule follow-up doc.
